propositions: rebar hardcodes DC comment ceiling to 32767, ignoring the admin-configurable jira.text.field.character.limit property, causing silent data loss when an administrator raises or removes the limit
comments longer than the hardcoded 32767 but within the instance's configured limit are truncated without the author's knowledge, creating permanent divergence between local and remote bodies
the comment sanitizer incorrectly couples to the description fitter (fit_outbound), which could retarget comment truncation rules if the description fitter ever changes
no existing integration probes the live jira.text.field.character.limit value at connect time, so configuration is the required remedy
DC comment ceiling is now configurable via ReconcilerConfig.comment_max_chars with range 0–2147483647 and default 32767, with configurability validated by red-first unit tests and mutation checks
